info.title: Private Payments API
info.description: Build an unsigned transaction that deposits SPL tokens from Solana into an ephemeral rollup.

post.description: Wraps the SDK `delegateSpl(...)` flow. The API generates `shuttleId` server-side and pins `escrowIndex` to `0`.

cluster.description: Optional, defaults to `mainnet`. `mainnet` and `devnet` route to the public ephemeral RPC for that network; `mainnet-private` and `devnet-private` route to the TEE-backed Private Ephemeral Rollup and are required for auth and bearer-token-gated reads. A custom http(s) RPC URL overrides only the base RPC while keeping the configured ephemeral RPC.

mint.description: Optional. Defaults to Solana USDC on mainnet: `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`. On devnet it defaults to devnet USDC: `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`.

amount.description: Base-unit amount as an integer JSON value with minimum 1.

validator.description: Optional. Defaults to the selected ephemeral RPC identity resolved via `getIdentity`.

initIfMissing.description: Optional. Defaults to `true`. Adds the instruction that initializes the owner's ephemeral ATA (eATA) if it does not exist. The transfer queue is initialized by `/v1/spl/initialize-mint`.

initVaultIfMissing.description: Optional. Initialize the vault if missing.

initAtasIfMissing.description: Optional. Initialize associated token accounts if missing.

idempotent.description: Optional. Defaults to `true`. Selects the deposit builder: `true` uses the shuttle flow, `false` the legacy direct deposit. Both leave the eATA delegated.

private.description: Optional. When `true`, the deposited balance is kept private.

gasless.description: Optional. Defaults to false. Uses the configured sponsor as payer and charges 0.2 USDC/USDT from the owner's existing base-chain ATA, in addition to amount. Requires an existing sponsor ATA, an on-curve owner, mainnet USDC/USDT or devnet USDC (including private clusters), and amount of at least 0.5 tokens. Custom clusters are unsupported. The returned transaction includes the sponsor signature; the owner must still sign.
